title: SourceConcept search expansion and evidence UI
summary: Adds read-only SourceConcept alias expansion through SourceConceptSearchIndex.
Adds compact media-detail SourceConcept chips with same-name grouping, collapsed evidence preview, unconfirmed/source-layer labeling, and disabled promotion preview.
Adds search-result expansion explanations and needs_review SourceConcept expansion when an explicit alias q search matches.

Fixes reviewer P1/P2 issues by omitting public concept keys, redacting canonicalized path/filename aliases, invalidating search cache after SourceConcept writes, and using uncapped concept ids for actual filtering.
Fixes reviewer P2 issues by gating detail/promotion lookups to visible statuses and quoting parser metacharacters in SourceConcept q= chip URLs.
Fixes manual-validation issues by making alias search concept-level and bidirectional across linked aliases, and by replacing debug-like cards with compact chips.
Preserves normal tag search and F6 q= chip behavior.
Does not create or mutate Entity truth paths, TagTranslation, media_tags, providers, LLMs, source storage, iCloud, or app-managed storage.

search_semantics.active_default: Active and needs_review SourceConcept aliases can expand matching explicit q terms as an OR inside the term.
search_semantics.multi_term: Existing AND semantics across query terms are preserved.
search_semantics.negative: Negative terms remain bounded by negating the same expanded term condition.
search_semantics.quoted: Quoted/exact terms stay one parser token and can match one exact alias search key; SourceConcept q= chips quote parser metacharacters such as colon, leading dash, wildcard characters, brackets, parentheses, and whitespace.
search_semantics.alias_closure: When one alias matches a visible SourceConcept, search expands through the concept alias closure so linked aliases such as 神里綾華, Kamisato Ayaka, and kamisato_ayaka produce the same SourceConcept-linked media set.
search_semantics.needs_review: needs_review SourceConcepts expand for explicit alias q search and remain labeled as unconfirmed source-layer; rejected, ambiguous, and superseded concepts stay hidden.
search_semantics.normal_tag_priority: Normal tag search remains intact and SourceConcept expansion only adds transparent source-layer matches.

browser_validation.metacharacter_chip: Re:Zero clicked through quoted q= search
browser_validation.compact_ui: SourceConcept media detail rendered compact chips; duplicate Kamisato Ayaka concepts grouped to one visible chip; evidence details were collapsed by default.

next_step: Open a normal PR, trigger @codex review, and stop. Do not start DOC1 or the Entity bridge.
